moving_interference_smooth_output_power..formula_or_claim: Normalized output power $\ell_t=10\log_{10}[(w_t^{\mathrm H}R_tw_t)/p_t^\star]$, $R_t=\sigma^2I_n+\tau^2h_th_t^{\mathrm H}$, $p_t^\star=(a^{\mathrm H}R_t^{-1}a)^{-1}$, with $n=32$, $\beta=0.97$. Blue, orange, pink and green solid curves denote the posterior mean $\overline P_t^+$, mode $P_{\widehat{\mathcal X}_t}$, matched isotropic mean $\overline P_t^{\mathrm{iso}}$ and GREAT (sliding window), respectively. Curves show means across 256 Monte Carlo simulations. Shaded regions show the pointwise 25th–75th percentiles across simulations. Means are arithmetic, using the 32 saved indices $t=8,16,\ldots,256$. These empirical simulation spreads are not posterior credible regions; table confidence intervals are unchanged. $\varphi_t=\varphi_0+2\varphi_0(t-1)/(T-1)$.
